preflight.ask: Q1. Is this export the whole vRO estate? If not, what is missing, and how many vRO nodes or clusters does the estate run on?
preflight.title: Q1 scope
preflight.why: Every count in Assess and Brief is only as complete as the export. A partial export hides callers and callees.
unblocks: assess: unexported calls
brief: retire candidates, waves
preflight.family_title: Preflight: what the export cannot say

preflight.ask: Q2. What starts these workflows from outside vRO? Two ways to answer, and they can be combined: put the vRA content export (a .vra-ng from Build Tools) in the export folder, and the tool reads its catalog items, cloud templates and event broker subscriptions; and list in your-input/entry-points.yaml whatever that export does not hold, or everything if there is no export: vRO scheduled tasks and policies, the ITSM (for example ServiceNow), and scripts calling the vRO REST API. Set complete: true there once the list is whole.
preflight.question: No vRA export was found. What starts these workflows from outside vRO? List it in entry-points.yaml next to this file, or put the vRA export in the export folder and run again.
preflight.title: Q2 external callers
preflight.why: None of these are in a vRO package. Without them every workflow nobody calls in the export looks like an entry point or dead code, and the two cannot be told apart.
unblocks: brief: retire pass, entry points, rebuild outcome
preflight.family_title: Preflight: what the export cannot say

preflight.ask: Q3. For each system the tool found (SSH hosts), is there a non-production instance a converted flow can run against? Name any other system the workflows reach.
preflight.title: Q3 non-production targets
preflight.why: A wave that writes to a target cannot be verified without somewhere safe to write. Read-only waves can go first either way.
unblocks: brief: wave entry criteria

preflight.ask: Q4. Is anything in this export off limits for this migration (owned by another team, frozen, vendor supplied, or due to be replaced)?
preflight.question: Is any of it off limits (another team's, frozen, vendor supplied, or being replaced)?
preflight.title: Q4 off limits
preflight.why: Off-limits workflows are dropped from the waves, and whatever calls them keeps a dependency on vRO.

preflight.ask: Q7. Can you export twelve months of workflow run history (vRO workflow tokens, or the vRA deployment history), with workflow ID, start time and result?
preflight.question: Can you export twelve months of run history: workflow, start time and result?
preflight.title: Q7 execution history
preflight.why: The retire rule is 'no executions in twelve months'. Without history it cannot be tested, only guessed from the call graph.
unblocks: brief: retire pass
preflight.family_title: Preflight: what the export cannot say

preflight.ask: Q8. The code uses these vRO plugins: HTTP-REST plugin (built in), SSH, the plugin of type AD. Is that the list? Correct it if not, and add the installed version per node and any custom or in-house plugin.
preflight.title: Q8 plugin inventory
preflight.why: A plugin object type Kestra cannot reach blocks every workflow that uses it. The export only records plugins by name where dunes-meta-inf lists them.
unblocks: assess: target inventory
preflight.suggested: HTTP-REST plugin (built in), SSH, the plugin of type AD
preflight.found: HTTP-REST plugin (built in) (REST requests built in callRest, launchJobTemplate, postSlackMessage, postTeamsMessage and 1 more); SSH (calls such as SSHSession.connectWithPassword, calls such as SSHSession.connectWithPasswordOrIdentity, calls such as SSHSession.disconnect, calls such as SSHSession.executeCommand); the plugin of type AD (object type AD:OrganizationalUnit, object type AD:UserGroup).
preflight.family_title: Preflight: what the export cannot say

confirmed.q8-plugin-inventory: HTTP-REST plugin (built in), SSH, the plugin of type AD
